COOP KLEPP SA (org.nr 913 426 789) is registered as Samvirkeforetak (SA), founded 1919-04-19, registered 1995-03-12. Business address: K.K. Kleppes veg 1, 4350 KLEPPE. Main industry (NACE): 47.110 Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler. Registered employees: 262 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 959,169,980; operating result NOK -5,456,679; net result NOK 26,228,400; total assets NOK 627,821,310; equity NOK 340,731,807 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 959,169,980). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) John Thysse; board chair Trond Inge Rødland; 7 other board members. Sub-units registered: 16.
